operators.name: group_norm_forward
semantics: Implements PyTorch nn.GroupNorm forward: normalize x over each group of channels using mean and variance computed per spatial location batch; x_norm = (x - mean) / sqrt(var + eps); apply affine weight and bias per channel.
Groups are formed by splitting C into num_groups contiguous channels; for C=3 and num_groups=3, each group has 1 channel, reducing to LayerNorm per channel per batch item.
Mean and variance are computed over all spatial positions and channels within each group for each batch element, using biased variance (divide by N). eps is added to variance before sqrt.
Affine parameters weight and bias are applied per channel: y = weight[channel] * x_norm + bias[channel]. If weight or bias is None, skip respective affine step.
The operation preserves input shape, dtype torch.float32, and device CUDA. Input may have arbitrary strides; the kernel must handle strided tensors correctly.
Forward uses float32 arithmetic for mean, variance, and normalization, then casts to float32 output; no dtype promotion.

operators.name: softmax_channel_forward
semantics: Implements PyTorch softmax over dimension 1 (channels). For each batch element and spatial position, softmax is computed over all C channel values: y[n,c,...] = exp(x[n,c,...] - max_c(x[n,:,...])) / sum_c exp(x[n,c,...] - max_c(x[n,:,...])).
Numerically stable using max subtraction. The computation is done in float32, output dtype torch.float32.
Input may have arbitrary strides; the kernel must handle strided tensors correctly and preserve output shape.
The softmax uses the exact reference behavior: torch.softmax(x, dim=1), which normalizes along channel dimension only.
Apply self.group_norm to input x. self.group_norm is nn.GroupNorm(3, 3, eps=1e-05, affine=True).
Input is x with shape [512, 3, 256, 256], float32 on CUDA.
Output is normalized tensor with same shape, dtype, device, and stride as input.
Uses affine weight and bias, each of shape [3], if not None.
Mean and variance computed per sample per group over all spatial dimensions and channels in that group.
Apply softmax over dimension 1 (channels) of x from step_001.
For each batch and spatial location, softmax is computed across the 3 channel values.
Output shape [512, 3, 256, 256], dtype torch.float32, device CUDA, same strides.
Uses stable softmax with max subtraction.
Return the softmax result from step_002 as the final output.
Output shape [512, 3, 256, 256], dtype torch.float32, device CUDA, stride [196608, 65536, 256, 1].
